text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san. Today is... your birthday, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you remembered. Thank you... Um, 
Zephyr, what's that you're holding in your 
hand...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Since it is your birthday... I shall 
present to you what I hold dearest... The 
'wind.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Ahaha, what a gentle, 
fluffy breeze! Thank you for such a 
wonderful gift, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Since it's Miracle's birthday, 
and we're always so close, I thought I'd 
try something a bit different—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I tried to stretch myself a bit... and 
made a joke, and... they actually seemed 
quite pleased with it. Hehe... hehehe. 
Hehehehe...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh! S-Sorry! Was I, um... supposed to 
make a comeback, or something?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"No. That's just like you... Miracle-san. 
The person who made me want to push myself 
further. ...Hehehe."
